title: Back to Hopscotch
summary: Almost a year after registering Hopscotch, I'm finally coming back to give the island the attention it deserves.
paragraphs: Hopscotch was registered on August 26th, 2025, but I never really finished building it. Most of the island is still pretty barren, so instead of restarting I'm treating this as a full rebuild.

The old island stays, the villagers stay, and all the progress I've already made counts — but from here I'm going to properly document everything as Hopscotch turns into the pink, froggy island I actually wanted.
This is my passport at the start of the rebuild: Violet, resident representative of Hopscotch, with peaches as the native fruit and a very appropriate passport title of Ultimate Egg.

images.alt: Violet's Animal Crossing New Horizons passport for Hopscotch at the beginning of the island rebuild
